intro: One cart, three graphs. Drag the cart along the track (or set its starting velocity and acceleration and press Run), and its position-time, velocity-time and acceleration-time graphs draw themselves as it moves. Tap any graph to read the slope and the area at that moment. In Match, drive the cart so its graph traces a target.
howItWorks:
• Slope of x-t = velocity. Steep means fast; rising means moving in the + direction; flat means at rest.
  • Slope of v-t = acceleration. A straight v-t line means constant acceleration. v and a with the same sign: speeding up; opposite signs: slowing down.
  • Area under v-t = displacement (area below the axis counts as negative); adding every area as positive gives the distance. Area under a-t = change in velocity.
  • In Set v and a the motion is exact: x = x₀ + v₀t + ½at² and v = v₀ + at, recomputed each frame from the time, so nothing drifts. Changing a while it runs starts a new straight piece on v-t.
  • In Drag and Match the detector records your position every frame; v and a are least-squares slopes over a short window, as a real motion detector computes them.
  • Free fall in the drills uses g = 9.8 m/s² downward with no air resistance; 10 m/s² is also accepted on the exam.

targets.name: Walk away slowly, stop, then come back faster
Go right steadily, then come straight back
Hold 1 m/s to the right, then stop
Speed up to the right, then slow to a stop
Right at 1 m/s, stop, then left at 1 m/s
